record.field: Create a new lead/opportunity in the CRM system when a potential customer shows interest. Use this when the conversation indicates sales potential.

result = { 'success': True, 'lead_id': False, 'message': '' } try: room_id = room.id if room else False agent_id = agent.id if agent else False # Get parameters name = params.get('name') or (room.display_name if room else False) or 'Lead from chat' contact_name = params.get('contact_name') email = params.get('email') phone = params.get('phone') description = params.get('description', '') # Create lead lead_vals = { 'name': name, 'contact_name': contact_name, 'email_from': email, 'phone': phone, 'description': description, 'type': 'opportunity', } # Link to chat room if available if room_id and 'chatroom_room_ids' in env['crm.lead']._fields: lead_vals['chatroom_room_ids'] = [(4, room_id)] # Link to partner if chat has linked contacts if room and room.partner_ids: lead_vals['partner_id'] = room.partner_ids[0].id lead = env['crm.lead'].create(lead_vals) # Add message with creation info if room_id and agent_id: agent = env['chatroom.ai.agent'].browse(agent_id) base_url = env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param('web.base.url') chat_url = f"{base_url}/web#action=chatroom.action_chatroom_app&room_id={room_id}" message_body = f'''

This lead was automatically created by AI agent {agent.name} from a chat conversation.

View source chat conversation

''' lead.message_post( body=message_body, subject='Lead created by AI', message_type='notification', subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note', ) result['lead_id'] = lead.id result['message'] = f'Lead "{name}" created successfully (ID: {lead.id})' except Exception as e: result['success'] = False result['message'] = f'Error creating lead: {str(e)}'
